# Haircraft by Brittany

> Independent hair stylist based in Bloomington, Indiana. Blonding, custom color, bold vivids and cuts that fit your life, from a licensed color specialist clients call thorough, honest and never pushy.

- Phone: (812) 606-2606

## Services
- Cuts & restyles: Haircuts of all lengths, built around how much styling you actually want to do, for women, men and kids.
- Custom color: Your own signature shade, mixed for you: rich reds, auburns, brunettes, glosses and root touch-ups.
- Blonding & highlights: Her specialty: full highlights, babylights and lowlights, toned to a blonde that grows out gracefully.
- Vivid color: Fire-engine red, plum and fashion shades for when you want to be seen.
- Styling & waxing: Blowouts, braided styles and curls for a big day, plus waxing. Ask about it when you book.
- Scalp & hair rehab: A gentle plan to bring stressed, over-processed hair and scalp back to health.

## About
Haircraft by Brittany is a one-stylist salon at 2312 S Rogers St on Bloomington's south side. It's bright and a little playful: a hot pink wall, black chairs, and shelves of Joico, Olaplex and Malibu C. Brittany Hash, a licensed color specialist, does every cut and every color herself, so you see the same person every visit. Her clients tend to stay for years. Reviewers describe her as thorough, honest, not pushy and super smart about hair. She mixes signature colors, takes the time to understand how much upkeep you really want, and has accommodated clients who are low vision or have sensory sensitivities from their very first visit. She's also a mom of two who builds her schedule around her family, so if a time isn't showing on the booking page, she isn't available that day. In her words: "Always accepting new clients of any race, religion, gender, and sexual orientation. If hate doesn't have a place in your life, you're welcome in my chair."

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Where is the salon?
  A: 2312 S Rogers St, Bloomington, IN 47403, on the south side of town.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Google currently lists Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 5 PM, closed Sunday. Brittany's schedule works around her family, so the Square booking page always shows the real open times.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online on the Haircraft by Brittany Square page, or call (812) 606-2606.
- Q: Do you specialize in blonde?
  A: Yes. Blonding is Brittany's specialty: full highlights, babylights, lowlights, toning and bringing grown-out or brassy blonde back to bright.
- Q: Do you do bright fashion colors?
  A: Yes. Vivid reds, plums and other bold shades are some of Brittany's favorite work, along with natural custom color.
- Q: I'm low vision or sensitive to noise and touch. Can you accommodate me?
  A: Tell Brittany when you book. Clients with low vision and sensory sensitivities say she has always made sure to accommodate them.
- Q: Can you help with damaged hair or buildup on my hair and scalp?
  A: Yes. Brittany has helped clients rehab stressed, over-processed hair and scalps, and offers Malibu C treatments that lift hard-water buildup, chlorine green and discoloration.
- Q: Do you offer waxing?
  A: Yes, waxing is on her booking page alongside cuts and color.
